opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other UK institutions of higher education, and (on a trial basis) UK-based independent research institutes/organisations defined as eligible by UKRI. Applicant must be employed by the eligible institution.
opportunities.summary: Funding for researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education to undertake an innovative and original research project. The outline application stage is paused and will be accepted in the new grants management system in autumn 2026; detailed applications are due by 1 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships

amount.raw: The maximum value of a Fellowship is £70,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the Fellowship duration; resident in the UK; permanent members of the UK scholarly community.
opportunities.summary: Funding for experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research, tenable for 3 to 24 months. Application materials will be available on the page in September 2026.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships

amount.raw: Applications are invited for a minimum value of £3,000 and a maximum of £24,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired (up to 0.5 FTE) from an academic post at a UK university or eligible institution, living in the UK for at least 26 weeks a year.
opportunities.summary: Funding for senior researchers who have retired or partially retired to complete a research project and prepare the results for publication, tenable for 3 to 24 months. Application materials will be available on the page during September 2026.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million is available for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities defined as institutions registered by the Office for Students holding their own research degree awarding powers. Each university may submit one application as principal applicant.
opportunities.summary: Funding for UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. The Centenary Research Centre round is expected to open in February 2027 for submission of outline applications in June 2027.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: The awards will be for up to £1 million, for staff salaries and associated costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career academics at UK universities with research degree awarding powers: at least two years post-PhD research/teaching experience, holding or nominated for a permanent academic appointment at lecturer level or equivalent.
opportunities.summary: Funding for talented early career scholars embarking on a university career to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem, over 4 to 5 years. The Centenary Research Leadership Awards will open in January 2028 for submission in May 2028.
